# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 55 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_055_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 55

**1** Jesus said: "Anyone who doesn't put me above father and mother can't be my disciple.

**2** Anyone who doesn't put me above brother and sister, and carry their cross the way I do, isn't worthy of me."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Put me above" — "hate" rendered as relative priority rather than active hatred
- "Carry their cross the way I do" — "in my way" rendered as following Jesus's manner

---
